root_idea.summary: A vague, indefinite place-denoting adverbial expression whose location is normally specified by a following clause.
root_idea.development: The basic locative expression extends, with ما, to the conditional sense “wherever” and, in later technical usage, to relational, causal, and resultative constructions.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Primary public citation form for the shared Quranic lexeme.
The LOC analysis represents the same written lexeme and its ordinary locative adverbial use.
The COND analysis is a constructional use of the same lexeme, represented in a separate conditional sense.

quranic_forms.public_pos_label: Adverbial noun · locative and conditional use

senses.definition: An indefinite adverbial noun of place: where, at the place where, or in whatever place.
senses.usage_conditions: Normally followed by a nominal or verbal clause that identifies the location. It may occur after مِنْ or another preposition, occupy an adverbial or objective position, and participate in a correlative construction meaning “where X is, there Y is.”

senses.definition: In the construction حَيْثُمَا or حَيْثُ مَا, wherever or in whatever place.
senses.usage_conditions: The accompanying ما gives the expression conditional force. In Classical grammatical usage, the construction may govern the following verbs in the jussive; a reported analysis also allows the related temporal sense “whenever.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: When or whenever, as a temporal adverbial expression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A less common Classical usage reported by some grammarians; it is distinct from the ordinary locative use and is not assigned here to a Quranic occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: As to, in respect of; considered as or merely as.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A scientific and post-Classical prepositional construction used to specify the aspect or consideration under which something is being discussed.
A post-Classical explanatory construction, especially مِنْ حَيْثُ إِنَّ...; بِحَيْثُ is also reported with this causal force in less formal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: So that; so as to; in such a state or condition that.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A post-Classical resultative or consequential construction, often used to express the resulting state or outcome of an action.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers the core locative use, conditional example, and reported temporal use.
The two-place correlative construction is covered by the locative sense.
Covers the حيثما conditional construction and its reported whenever interpretation.
Covers the later relational, causal, and resultative constructions.

cautions: The QAC N, LOC, and COND analyses are merged under the single citation form حَيْثُ; the conditional analysis is represented as a constructional sense.
Lane records variant vocalizations including حَيْثَ, حَيْثِ, and حَوْثُ. The public headword follows the Quranic form حَيْثُ.
